apps.name: JellyMuse
apps.localizedDescription: Jellyfin Music Client that mimics Apple Music

versions.localizedDescription:
Apple Music-style sliders, matching buttons and text, and Sing improvements.

• Progress and volume bars rebuilt to follow Apple Music: the same heights and springs, a fill that always stays attached to the bar, and a vertical drag away to cancel a scrub
• Volume bar stretches at both ends like Apple Music, its fill glides a little after a flick, and the stretch stays level with the speaker icons
• Slider haptics removed
• Artist name and the lyrics, AirPlay and queue buttons now share the progress bar's blend and brightness; lyrics and queue use the same slider look as the main view
• Sing is now offered for Atmos songs that have a stereo version (streamed, or downloaded with the regular file); only an Atmos-only download hides it
• Sing turns itself back on after a song without lyrics, when the next song with lyrics plays
• The mesh background eases out as soon as you leave lyrics for the main view, instead of waiting for the animation to finish
• Fixes: the Favorite button in the ellipsis menu now shows whether the song is favorited
